scenarios.title: A｜表达观点
scenarios.setting: 老师让大家讨论社交媒体对学生生活的影响。

turns.text: Do you think social media has had a positive or negative effect on students?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I think it has both positive and negative effects.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it has both positive and negative effects.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: In my opinion, it can be useful, but it can also be distracting.

feedback.naturalExpression: In my opinion, it can be useful, but it can also be distracting.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think it depends on how people use it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it depends on how people use it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Personally, I think the negative effects are more noticeable.

feedback.naturalExpression: Personally, I think the negative effects are more noticeable.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: In my opinion, I think social media is…

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I think it has both positive and negative effects.
feedback.explanation: In my opinion 和 I think 重复

turns.text: Can you explain what you mean?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: For example, it’s useful for staying in touch, but people can spend too much time on it.

feedback.naturalExpression: For example, it’s useful for staying in touch, but people can spend too much time on it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: One advantage is that information is easy to share. The downside is that it can be distracting.

feedback.naturalExpression: One advantage is that information is easy to share. The downside is that it can be distracting.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think the main problem is that it’s very easy to lose track of time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think the main problem is that it’s very easy to lose track of time.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: From my experience, it can be helpful when it’s used in moderation.

feedback.naturalExpression: From my experience, it can be helpful when it’s used in moderation.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Does anyone have a different perspective?
